content: YAMBƗSƗK YILA TAAGWAT
Ndina ngegavat yindi maa Jisas Oliv walɨnja nduwiat wokendɨ.
Nat nandinya ngambi nglei dailaa God kat kwunatɨnja ngay wuleindɨ maa nɨma sakwat nɨmba ndɨ kat yandi maa ndɨ ndaa lɨga ndi kat vɨsɨmogwindɨ.
Vɨsɨmogwi lɨndɨ maa Judana lo kat sɨmogwi la nɨmbo Ferisio taagwa kwutaa ndɨna lak kalindi. Wat taagwa yambɨsɨk yilɨnja vak kwutaa lɨla vak vɨlaa lɨ kat kwutaa kalindi.
Kalilaa Jisas kat wagalandi. Njambwi nyan wat taagwa yambɨsɨk yilɨnja vak kwutaa lɨlɨ, vɨnɨn.
Moses nɨn kat tamba kwiya lomba wandɨ. Yamɨsɨk yilɨga nɨmba kat tamba kwiya lomba wandɨ. Yambɨsɨk yilɨga nɨmba kat vatnya ngwula waa wandɨ. Mɨn angamak walɨgamɨn waa Jisas kat wagalandi.

Kavle nyaangɨt mbutndeyan ndɨ kat nɨma vat yigiyanɨn waa yelavɨtaa wagalandi. Wagalandi maa Jisas ndi kat ana awat wandɨ. Valolaa lɨga sɨt taambamba kɨpmamba pɨlɨwutndɨ. Nɨn kat ana wutɨgandɨ waa yelavɨka lɨndi.
Ngi kat tɨga ndɨ kat wagala wagala lɨndi. Jisas laaptaa ndi kat wandɨ. Ngwutna kɨta nyan kavle vat yilapman yilɨgiya nyan ndɨ kambak kwutaa wat taagwa kat vatnyvat tat yaagigiyandɨ
waa walaa valolaa nat njambɨ kɨpmamba pɨlɨwutndɨ.

Ndɨnai waa nyaangɨt wuta nɨmba ndina maawupmba yelavɨtndi. Nɨn kavle vak yiga yetɨlapman nɨmba ana nɨn waa yelavɨtaa wup yilaa kwagalalaa wogwendi. Njambwi nɨmba tak wogwendi. Nat nɨmba ndina kwupmba wogwendi. Wogwendi maa Jisaso wat taagwo mbɨk kapma lɨmbɨt.
Jisas laaptaa taagwa kapma lɨlangat vɨlaa lɨ kat wandɨ. Nyɨn kat vatnyavat yalaa la nɨmba andambpa lɨgandi. Nyɨn kat kai walɨga nɨmba andamapa lɨgandi waa wandɨ.
Wandɨ maa walɨ. njambwi nyan ndi tamba yindi. Walɨ maa wandɨ. Nyɨn kat wuno kai ana waigowun. Ngɨni kavle vat wata yinyeya. Kwo ay nyɨla waa wandɨ Jisas.
WUN GODNA NYAN WUN WAA WANDI JISAS

Jisas nat njambɨ ndi kat wandɨ. Wun kɨpma lɨga nɨmba kat apma vat kwilɨga nyan wun. Vɨkemba ya vla lɨgowun. Kɨta nyan wuna kwupmba yandeyan kulun wala kavle vat kwagalalaa ya vɨtɨgiya kavamba yetɨvla apma vat yetɨgiyandɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.
Wandɨ mala Ferisi Jisas kat wandi. Wun njambwi nyan wun avla walɨma vat ana nglaatndɨ.
Wandi maa Jisas awat ndi kat wandɨ. Wuna lak waweyan nglaatndɨ. Yawa kava vɨga lɨgowun. Ngɨni yiweya kava vɨga lɨgowun. Yalaa yiweya kava ngwut ana vɨga lɨgangwuk.
Ngwuk kɨpmana vapmba nat nɨmba kat vɨlaa sɨga nagulɨgangwuk.
Ndi kat vɨlaa sɨga naguweyan ndina maawupmba lɨga vak kat vɨlaa apma vat savagu sɨga nagugiyowun. Wun kapma lɨga ana sɨga nagugiyowun. Wun kat ay waa nyan wuna nyaek wunamba lɨndɨ, sɨga nagugiywoun.
Ngwutna ngepmana vak kɨngiyan pɨoɨwutnja. Vɨlɨlɨk palɨ laataa kɨta vak kɨta nyaangɨt mbupmbeyan wan nyaangɨt ana ndaigiyandɨ waa walɨgangwuk.
Wun kɨta nyan njambwi nyanat tɨwa vat wun avla walɨgowun. Wun kat ay waa nyan wuna nyaek ndɨno njambwi nyanat tɨwa vat dɨ walɨgandɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.
Wandɨ mala ndi wandi. Mɨna nyaek andamapmba lɨgandɨ waa wandi maa Jisas wandɨ. Wun kat ana vɨga lɨgangwuk. Wun kat vɨga lɨgengwan wuna nyaek kat vɨga lɨgengwuk waa Jisas wandɨ.

Wan nyaangɨt God kat kwunatɨnja ngay ndi kat sɨmogwivat wuleilaa sanya nagilɨnja kavamba mbutɨndɨ. Mbutɨndɨ mala ndɨ kat kavle vat yivat ana kwutaa kalindi. Ndɨ kat kwutaa kalinjeya njɨmbla wata ana ngway tolaa lɨgandɨ.
YIWEYA KAVA ANA YIGIYANGWUK WAA JISAS WANDƗ
Jisas ndi kat nat njambɨ wandɨ. Yiwun maa wun kat kwaka vɨleviga kavle vat tɨga kiyaigangwuk. Yiweya kava ana yaigangwuk waa wandɨ.
Wandɨ maa Juda wagalandi. Avla anagandɨ vatnyagiya. Yiweya kava ana yaigangwuk waa manda kat wandɨ waa wagalandi.
wagalandi maa Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Ngwut kɨpmana nɨmba ngwuk. Wun nyinangwutna nyan wun. An kapma kapma nda li.
Ngi kat tɨga ngwuk kat wowun. Kavle vat tɨga liyaigangwuk waa wowun. Wun kat vɨlaa ndɨ God wandɨ yaa nyana waa yelavɨtapman yingweyan ngwut kavle savle lɨga kiyaigangwuk waa wandɨ Jisas.
Wandɨ maa wandi. Mɨn anda nyan mɨn waa wandi maa Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Tat ngwuk kat tɨwa vat tamba mbukwun. Mandɨt vak ana mbukiyowun.
Ngwuk kat mbukweya nyaangɨt nɨma sakwat tɨndɨ maa vɨlaa sɨga nagugiyowun. Wun kat ay waa nyan savagu vapmba vɨga sɨga nagulɨgandɨ.
Wanda nyaangɨt wutaa wuna ngaek waa God kat wanda vak ana wuka vɨga lɨndi.

Jisas ndi kat nat njambɨ wandɨ. Wun Godna vat ndinyangu kat mbutɨga nyan wun. Ngɨni wun kat kwutaa katsolaa wun kat diwai krosmba kaalandi maa ndi wun kat vɨlaa dɨ God wandɨ, yaa nyana waa waigandi. Ndɨ ndɨnai yelavɨtɨga vapmba ana njɨvwa kwutɨgandɨ. Ndɨna nyaek wandɨ maa nyaek waa vapmba njɨvwa kwuka nyaangɨt mbutɨgandɨ waa waigandi.
Wun kat ay waa wan nyan wun kat ana kwagalaa lɨgandɨ. Kapma ana tɨlɨgowun. Ndɨnai maawupmba yelavɨka wanda vapmba mɨna njɨvwa kwutɨgowun waa wandɨ Jisas.
Wan nyaangɨt wandɨ maa nɨma sakwat nɨmba wutaa ndi ndina maawupmba yelavɨka kwutaa lɨndi. Jisas God wandɨ, yaa nyana waa yelavɨka lɨndi.
JISAS WAA NYAANGƗT NDI KAT KWUNAKIYANDƗ
Ndɨ kat wuka kwutaa lɨngwa vak ke kwagalangwa. Kwagalapman yingweyan wuna mbaapma nɨmba tɨgiyangwuk.
Wun kat kwagalalapman yingweyan wunai waa nyaangɨt wuka kwutaa lɨngweyan mbambala ngwuk kat ngila la vɨga la kavle vat ngɨlɨgiyandɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.
Jisas wandɨ maa Juda ndɨ kat wandi. Nɨn Ebrahamna nyangu nɨn. Nat nɨmba nɨn kat ana kandi kwutaa kalilaa nɨn kat vɨga lɨndi. Manda kat ngwuk kat kwutaa vɨga la vak ngɨlɨgiyandɨ waa wamɨn waa wandi.
Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Ngwuk kat woseka ana waigowun. Awuk ngwula. Kavle vat yiga yetɨlɨga nyan wan kavle vat ndɨ kat ngilaa lɨgandɨ.

Kɨta nyan ngayna njɨvwa kwupmak kat ndɨ kat kematndi maa tɨndeyan ndɨ wan ngaymba njɨmbla njɨmbla ana lɨgiyandɨ. Wan ngayna apma nda ngɨni ndɨ ana klaigandɨ. Ndɨ njɨvwa kwuta nyan mɨna lɨgandɨ. Wan ngay vɨga la nyana nyan ndɨ wan ngaymba njɨmbla njɨmbla tɨga ngayna apma nda klaigandɨ.
Wun Godna nyan wun. Ngwuk kat ngilaa lɨga nda njalakweyan apma nglei vat tɨga Godnana apma nglei nda klaigangwuk.
Nɨn Ebrahamna nyangu nɨn waa walɨgangwuk. Vɨga lɨgowun. Mbutɨwa nyaangɨt wupmak kat kai waa wun kat vatnyavat tɨgangwuk.
Wuna nyaek tɨga kavamba tɨga vɨwa vat ngwuk kat mbutɨgowun. Ngwutno ngwutna nyaek yeta vla yetɨgangwuk waa wandɨ Jisas.
NGWUTNA NYAEK SETEN WAA WANDƗ JISAS
Wandɨ maa Juda wandi. Nɨna nyaek Ebraham waa wandi maa Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Ebraham ngwutna nyaek ana ndɨ. Ebraham ngwutna nyaekna tɨgendan ndɨnai yeta vla yetɨgengwuk. Wupma kai.

Wun Godnanamba wutuwa nyaangɨt ngwuk kat mbutɨgowun. Woseka waluwa vat ana ndɨ. Wan nyaangɨt wutaa wun kat vatnyavat tɨgangwuk. Mbambala God kwiya nyan kat kai walɨngwa vla tamba la nyan Ebraham wupma God kwiya nyan kat ana kai walɨndɨ.

Ngwutna nyaek nat nyana. Ngwutna nyaek yeta vla yetɨlɨgangwuk waa Jisas wandɨ maa Juda ndɨ kat wandi. Nɨn avla ana laataa lɨganɨn. God wandɨ mala laataa lɨganɨn. God nɨna nyaekna. Ndɨna kwundi mɨna wuka liganɨn waa wandi maa Jisas wandɨ.
God ngwutna nyaeknat tɨgendan gwuk wun kat vɨlaa woviyaguga lɨgengwuk. Ndɨnai lɨga kavamba tɨwun maa wun kat wandɨ maa yawun. Wunai yelavɨkna vapmba ana yawun. Ndɨ wandɨ maa yawun.
Ngwuk kat mbutɨwa nyaangɨt ngwutna maawut ana yelavɨka lɨgandɨ. Mbutɨwa nyaangɨt ana alɨpsɨga wuka lɨgangwuk.

Ngwutna nyaek yelavɨka vapmba yelavɨka lɨgangwuk. Ngwutna nyaek Seten. Ngwutna nyaek kavle vak yilɨnda vla wupma yilɨgangwuk. Tamba nat nɨmba kat vatnyalaa nyana. Ndɨ woseka walɨga nyana. Ndɨna maawupmba yelavɨka kwovak kwovak woseka mɨna walɨgandɨ. Ndɨ woseka walɨga nɨmbana njambwi nyana.
Wun ana ngwuk kat woseka walɨwun maa ndɨ woseka walɨgandɨ waa walɨgangwuk wun kat.
Wun kavle vat ana yilɨgowun. Wan yɨwa kavle vat wun kat sɨmaga ngwula. Vɨlu. Ana alɨpsɨga sɨmagaiyangwuk. Ngi kat tɨga ndɨ woseka walɨgandɨ waa manda kat walɨgangwuk wun kat.
Godna nyangu ndina nyaek waa vak wuka lɨgandi. Ngwuk Godna nyangu ana ngwuk. Ngi kat tɨga God waa vak ana wuka lɨgangwuk waa wandɨ Jisas.

Wandɨ maa Juda wandi. Tak ndɨ kat Sameriana nyana tungwengwan yiga lɨga nyana waa walɨnɨn. Tak ndɨnamba kavle waagan tavindɨ mala kavle vat yilɨndɨ waa walɨnɨn. Ngiyambak walɨnɨn waa wandi maa Jisas ndi kat wandɨ.
Wun kavle waagan tavi lɨga nyan ana wun. Wuna nyaekna sɨ mɨna kwutaa katsolɨgowun. Ngwuk wuna sɨ kwutaa viyasanda lɨgangwuk.
Wuna sɨ avla kwutaa katsovak kat ana kan njɨvwa kwutɨgowun. Nat nyan wuna sɨ kwutaa katsovak walɨgandɨ. Wuna sɨ kwutaa viyesanda lɨga nɨmba kat ndɨ kat nɨma vat yigiyandɨ.
Ngwuk kat woseka ana waigowun. Awuk ngwula. Kɨta nyan mbutɨwa nyaangɨt wuka yetɨndeyan ndɨ ana kiyaigandɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.

Jisas wandɨ maa Juda wandi. Wama vak wutaa kavle waagan mɨnamba tavilaa lɨnda vak vɨga lɨganɨn. Tak mɨn wamɨn. Kɨta nyan mbutɨwa nyaangɨt wuka yetɨndeyan ndɨ ana kiyaigandɨ waa wamɨn. Ebrahamo tamba la profetno tamba kiyandi luwa.
Nɨna walanga Ebraham ndɨ tamba kiyandɨ. Mɨn ndɨ kat kwulatɨgamɨn? E? Ndɨ mat nyana? Mɨn ndɨna njambwi mɨn? Tamba la profet ndino tamba kiyandi. Mɨn ndi kat kwulatɨgamɨn? Waa njɨka wagalandi.
Wagalandi maa Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Avla wuna sɨ kwutaa katsoweyan nɨma nda ana ndɨ. Wuna nyaek God ndɨ wuna sɨ kwutaa katsolɨgandɨ.

Ngwuk ndɨna mɨndama ana vɨga lɨgangwuk. Wun wuka vɨga lɨgowun. Ana vɨga lɨgowun waa waweyan woseka walɨngwa vak vla wupma wigowun. Woseka ana waigowun. Ndɨna mɨndama vɨga lɨgowun. Ndɨnai waa vapmba yetɨlɨgowun.
Ngwula walanga Ebraham tɨwa vat vɨlaa solat sɨlɨndɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.
Wandɨ maa Juda wandi. Mɨna ndɨmwe ndumi vɨli kiyeli tamba vɨli ana ndɨ. Ebraham kat angamak yila vɨmɨn waa njɨka wagalandi.
Wagalandi mala Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. ngwuk kat ana woseka wowun. Tamba wunai ta njɨmbla Ebraham wata ana lɨndɨ waa wandɨ Jisas.

Jisas wandɨ maa ndɨ kat vatnyavak kambak klaa kwutaa lɨndi. Jisas pagwuga yiga God kat kwunatɨnja ngaymba lɨga wogwendɨ. Ndi nɨma sakwat nɨmba yisolaa lɨndi, ndɨ pagwuga yiga yisolaa la nɨmba kat kwagalalaa yindɨ.
